# llm-dev-proxy

> Local HTTP proxy for LLM APIs that caches exact responses on disk for development: canonical JSON keys, auth headers never stored, record, replay and passthrough modes Go module `github.com/Trysac/u109-llm-dev-proxy`, package `llmdevproxy`, MIT licensed,
> Go >= 1.23, standard library only.
